headline: Unbeaten trio have conceded four goals apiece
dek: Frostburg State, West Liberty and Davis & Elkins are the three sides yet to lose, and each has let in exactly four goals. The other seven programmes have fifteen defeats between them, and West Virginia Wesleyan account for four of those on their own.
displaced_by: Midweek results moved the unbeaten sides' figures on; seven conceded in eight was no longer true, and each of the three now sits on exactly four against

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Charleston's fourteen goals have come from nine different scorers, and no one of them has more than three; the scoring is spread, not carried.

wire.line: Every programme has now conceded, and only West Virginia Wesleyan are still without a win.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Charleston have won four of their five matches and scored fourteen goals; their one defeat came at home to a visitor from outside the conference.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Josiah Emerson has made fourteen saves and conceded three goals for Frostburg State, the fewest goals against of any listed keeper.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: West Virginia Wesleyan have lost all four of their matches, three of them to conference opponents, and have scored three goals while conceding nine.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Shawnee State have scored eleven goals and conceded thirteen; six of the eleven came in a single match.

findings.label: signal
findings.text: Leyton Collier's fourteen shots have produced three goals for West Liberty; no other player on the leaders list has taken more than ten.

last_match.line: Charleston remain the only side to have won both of their conference matches; Salem's opening wins have been followed by consecutive defeats.

next_match.line: Davis & Elkins are still unbeaten; Point Park won their first conference match and lost their second.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
